items.title: Add root invariant checks for formal Layer 2/3 suite aggregation
items.context: Before a formal Engineering or Loop Engineering suite can PASS, every final-report.json in the selected final PASS root must match the expected layer, current head/material hash, single suiteRunId, expected claimTarget, non-local capability proof posture, and no authority overclaim.
items.userSees: baseline_suite_report for Engineering or Loop Engineering returns BLOCKED when the selected formal proof root contains mixed root-invariant final reports, and PASS only for a clean current-run root.

happy.desc: A clean Layer 2/3 formal proof root with one suiteRunId and expected claimTarget can still aggregate normally.

edge.desc: A final-report for the same baseline with a different suiteRunId or claimTarget inside the selected root blocks the suite before claim unlock.

adversarial.desc: A higher-layer or authority-overclaim artifact inside the selected root cannot be ignored to produce a PASS suite.

items.title: Add stale and mixed artifact negative coverage
items.context: Tests must prove stale materialHash, mixed suiteRunId, wrong claimTarget, localOnly, and higher-layer overclaim artifacts fail closed without turning local CLI evidence into Authority evidence.
items.userSees: The baseline smoke task reports PASS for negative controls proving stale materialHash, mixed suiteRunId, wrong claimTarget, localOnly, and Authority overclaim artifacts fail closed.

happy.desc: Smoke coverage includes a clean formal proof path that still passes after adding the invariant guard.

edge.desc: Smoke coverage includes mixed suiteRunId and wrong claimTarget artifacts and observes BLOCKED output.

adversarial.desc: Smoke coverage includes localOnly or Authority-overclaim artifacts and verifies receiptVerified/productionDone/fullAuthorityDone remain false.

items.title: Update the artifact isolation execution plan with implementation evidence
items.context: The decision document should describe the implemented guard precisely and preserve the Layer 4 boundary as a precondition until a production-safety evaluator exists.
items.userSees: The artifact isolation execution plan states that the invariant guard is implemented for Layer 2/3, stale traps use a negative-check root, and Layer 4 remains gated by its own Authority-backed evaluator.

happy.desc: The execution plan documents the implemented root invariant and exact supported scope for Layer 2/3.

edge.desc: The execution plan keeps Layer 4 as a precondition-only consumer until its production-safety evaluator exists.

adversarial.desc: The execution plan forbids treating artifact isolation or host verdicts as Authority evidence.
